recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-48095 in FHIR core unless the work group separately wants to revisit the still-related but distinct FHIR-47966/THO value-set work.
issue_request: FHIR-48095 was Applied with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked for the incomplete ImagingSelection.category definition to be expanded, and the final resolution also changed ImagingSelection.category from an Example binding to a Preferred binding while updating nearby ImagingSelection.code definitions and the code/category narrative.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 8c191fee9fef13eb2121c299a39307bb34cc8b01, which updated source/imagingselection/structuredefinition-ImagingSelection.xml and source/imagingselection/imagingselection-notes.xml. The Jira comment links PR HL7/fhir#3319 for that application.
additional_context: ImagingSelection is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition keeps ImagingSelection.category at Preferred strength. Later FHIR-47966 changed ImagingSelection.code to a THO value set with Preferred strength, but that later code-binding work does not undo or conflict with the FHIR-48095 category definition and category binding outcome.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source already reflects the approved category definition, the Preferred category binding, and the concise code/category narrative needed for this issue.
